Commentary.Commentary: The pitch looks to be on the slower side and the hosts have a variety of slow bowlers in their ranks. It looks a stiff target for the visitors but with the series on the line, expect them to fight hard. Weather will also be a factor. Chase coming up shortly...

Angelo Mathews, who promoted himself up the order failed to get into the act from the word go. But once he settled, he added some valuable runs in the end. After the opening stand broke, the Zimbabwean bowlers had a good run in the middle. They picked up 5 wickets for 54 runs and choked the Lankans. Malcolm Waller was the pick of them with his 2/44 in 10 overs.

Zimbabwe have pulled things back well towards the end but still failed to restrict the Lankans under 300. They would now be ruing their sloppy fielding. The opening duo of Niroshan Dickwella and Danushka Gunathilaka once again proved a thorn in flesh of the visitors. They created history by posting 200-plus stands in consecutive ODIs. Dickwella went on to score his second century while his partner fell short this time.

OUT! Wicket off the last ball! Short delivery at a slower pace. Mathews waits for it and tries to hit it over the backward point region. Fails to get the elevation on it as the ball goes straight into the hands of Hamilton Masakadza who accepts it gleefully. The skipper departs on the final ball of the innings and SRI LANKA END ON 300/6.
Fuller outside off, Hasaranga dances down the track and carves it towards sweeper cover for a single. 300 up for Sri Lanka.
Dug in short and Hasaranga ducks under it. The batsmen is not happy that it was not signaled as a wide.
Short and outside off, Mathews comes down the track and pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Good length delivery outside off, Wanidu guides it through the gap between backward point and short third man. The batsmen run three in the process as the fielder gives it a chase.
Short delivery outside off at a slower pace, Hasaranga tries to play the ramp shot but he fails to make contact.
Tendai Chatara is back on for the last over.
Dug in short outside off, Mathews lets it through thinking off it as a wide but the umpire finds it a legal delivery. End of an impressive over from Mpofu.
Bye! Another short delivery outside off, Hasaranga comes down the track and has a wild swing on it. Fails to hit it as the ball goes to the keeper. Moor misfields and allows a bye.
Another slower delivery outside off, Hasaranga tries to go over the cover region but gets beaten by the pace this time.
Slower delivery outside off, Hasaranga comes down the track and swings his bat but fails to make contact this time.
FOUR! Bowls a full toss around middle and leg, Hasaranga comes down the track and goes over the fielder at mid off and gets a boundary to his name. Terrific batting by the youngster.
Long off comes inside the circle.
Again a misfield! Short and wide outside off, Mathews smashes it towards covers where Sean Williams misfields and allows a single.
Fuller outside off, driven towards long off for a single to keep strike. 14 runs off the over.
Hasaranga prods forward and defends it on the leg side for a quick single.
FOUR! Short and punished! Hasaranga stays back to the short delivery outside off, pulls it powerfully through the wide mid on region for a boundary.
Floated around leg, Mathews defends it on the leg side for a single.
SIX! That's gone the distance! Fuller around off, Mathews comes a bit down the track and unleashes his power on it. Hits it dead straight over the bowler's head for a biggie.
Tosses this one fuller outside off, driven towards long off for a single.
Short and wide outside off, Hasaranga cuts it towards the fielder at covers. A single is taken.
Low full toss down the leg side, Mathews flicks it towards fine leg for a single.

Slow full toss outside off, Mathews just pushes it through the mid on region. Runs the first run hard and calls for the second this time as well. The fielder from the deep has a shy at the non-striker's end but he misses. Hasaranga dives to make his crease.
Short delivery outside off, Mathews pulls it through the mid-wicket region for a brace.
Fuller outside off, mistimes his drive back to the bowler.
Shorter outside off, Hasaranga pulls it through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Short around off, Hasaranga pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single to keep strike.
Fuller into the pads, Mathews flicks it through mid-wicket. Runs the first run hard but Raza is quick to the ball which denies them the second.
Clipped towards square leg for a single.
Again a reverse sweep but this time by Mathews. Gets it towards short third man for a single.
Around off, Hasaranga reverse sweeps it through the cover region for a single.
Floats it outside off, Hasaranga prods forward in defence.
Wanidu Hasaranga is the new man in.

OUT! Golden duck for Mendis! Short delivery and Mendis goes for the pull. Hits it into the wind and the deep mid-wicket fielder sits comfortably underneath it. Waller doesn't make any mistake and Mendis has to depart without disturbing the scorers.
Short and wide outside off, Mathews pushes it towards covers for a single.
Full toss in the line of the stumps, Mathews clips it through the mid-wicket region for a couple.
Kusal Mendis is the next man in. He finally makes his way in.

OUT! After disastrous fielding, this is something special from Williams! Short of a length delivery into the body, Gunaratne tries to make room and go over the infield on the off side. Does not make the desired contact as he just manages to loft over mid off. Sean tracks back from mid off and takes a superb catch to send Asela back to the hut.
Mathews clips it through the mid-wicket region for a single.

Leg bye! Back of a length delivery, nipping in. Asela Gunaratne tries to clip it on the leg side but misses it completely. Gets hit on the thigh pad and the ball rolls away on the off side for a leg bye.
Chris Mpofu is back for a bowl.
Asela flicks it away with a wristy shot and have run through for a single. He is off the mark straightaway.
Asela Gunaratne makes his way out to the middle.

OUT! Dragged on! Full outside off, spinning away. Tharanga gets across and kneels down for a slog sweep. Gets an under edge onto the middle pole. Raza is delighted. Zimbabwe are pulling things back at the right time. Sri Lanka seem to be losing the plot here.

FOUR! That was absolutely murdered! Tharanga dances down the track and smacks it straight down the track on the full. Gets it through the gap between the bowler and the stumps. It's hit with so much power that there's no stopping it. The intent has to be same going forward.
Served outside off, Tharanga gets across, kneels down to slog sweep but misses it completely.
Served around leg, turned on the leg side for a single.

Tossed up outside off, spinning away, Tharanga looks to loft it over covers but mistimes it high in the air. Luckily, it falls wide of Masakadza in the ring, who collects it on the bounce. A single is taken.
Sikandar Raza is back on.
Again a couple. Just pushed through the wide mid off region. The bowler gives it a chase but he cannot deny the batsmen two vital runs.
Brilliant running! Mathews just punches it through the cover region and   runs two quick runs.
Wide outside off, Mathews goes for it but he fails to make contact. Unlucky to be not signaled as a wide.
SIX! Fuller in line of the stumps, Mathews just smashes that over the long on region for a maximum. With the wind and the ball sails over the fence.
Tharanga clips it towards long on for a single.

Fuller around off, Mathews clips it through the mid-wicket region for a brace. The fielder from the deep rushes to the ball and has a shy at the non-striker's end. Williams cannot collect the ball due to a wayward bounce and that results into an overthrow. Three runs taken.
Sean Williams is back into the attack.

A bit short into his hips, Tharanga nudges it towards the mid-wicket region. Runs the first run hard and calls for the second. Mathews responds quickly and they complete the second run easily. Waller ends with figures of 10-0-44-2.

NOT OUT! Floated outside off, Tharanga goes to slog it but misses it. The keeper collects it and starts appealing, the bowler joins him as well. The umpire, however, stays undisturbed. The keeper convinces his skipper to opt for the review and Cremer obliges. Replays show there was no bat involved on it and Tharanga is safe. Zimbabwe waste their review as well and Moor will be surely disappointed.
Moor appeals confidently for caught behind but the umpire stays unmoved. Waller also has heard some sound and Zimbabwe have reviewed it.
Short and wide outside off, Tharanga cuts it straight to the fielder at point.

SIX! Tharanga gets in the mood! Upul dances down the track, reaches to the pitch of the ball and smacks that over the long on region for half a dozen. First one of the day and Sri Lanka will need more of these.
Into the pads, clipped in front of square leg for a single.
Short outside off, Mathews punches it towards the fielder at covers.
Tharanga clips it towards the mid-wicket region where Masakadza misfields to allow a brace.
Around off, Tharanga fails to put bat on ball.

FOUR! Timed to perfection! Floated outside off, Tharanga waits for it and just chips it over the extra cover region for a boundary. Timing and placement was exquisite there. First boundary in the last six overs.
Quicker outside off, Tharanga fancies the reverse sweep but fails to make contact.
Into the pads, clipped towards short fine leg for a single.
Fuller outside off, Mathews drives his straight back to his counterpart.
Powerplay 3 has been signaled. Now, 5 fielders are allowed outside the ring.
Tossed up around off, Tharanga goes for the drive but only manages to get an inside edge onto his pads. 13/2 in the last 5 overs. What a comeback from Zimbabwe!
Quicker through the air, Tharanga prods forward but is surprised by the extra pace on the ball as he tries to defend it.
Mathews clips it towards the mid-wicket region for a single.
On a length outside off, Mathews goes for the cut. Gets an inside edge past the stumps towards short fine leg.
Wide! Sprays it down the leg side, Mathews lets it through.
Mathews stays in his crease and defends it.
Driven towards long off for a single.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. One run added to the total.

A miscommunication but safe! Floated outside off, Tharanga mistimes his drive towards extra cover. The fielder there misfields and the batsmen think of running a single. Tharanga, however, sends his skipper back who has to dive to get back in time. Luckily for him, the fielder was slow to react.
Tossed up outside off, Tharanga mistimes his punch towards extra cover.
Around middle and off, Mathews drives it towards long off for a single.
Fuller around off, Angelo drives it back to the bowler.
Tossed up outside off, Mathews cuts it towards the fielder at point.
Shorter around off, Tharanga cuts it towards the fielder at point.
Upul Tharanga is the new man in.

OUT! Dickwella has to depart! Fuller into the stumps, Niroshan goes way across the line of the ball and tries to play the sweep. Fails to make contact and he gets hit low on the pads. The players appeal and the umpire is quick to raise his dreaded finger. Dickwella starts walking but Mathews calls him back and asks him to go for the review. Replays show that there was no bat involved. Ball Tracker shows that the ball was pitched in line, impact was in line and it was going on to hit the stumps. That means three reds and the umpire's decision stands. Sri Lanka have wasted their review. End of a superb knock from the opener. He has done his job, laid a superb platform for his teammates.
Niroshan Dickwella has been adjudged lbw. He however, has gone for the review. If he hasn't got any glove or bat on it, the centurion is a goner.
Tossed up around middle and leg, Dickwella camps back and punches it on the off side. The ball had kept low and Niroshan did well to adjust.
Floated outside off, Dickwella shuffles way across and goes for the sweep but he fails to make contact.
Dickwella comes down the track and gets it over the extra cover region for a couple.
A bit short outside off, bounces a bit more off the deck. Dickwella goes for the reverse sweep yet again but this time fails to make contact as he is beaten by the extra bounce.
Mathews camps back and punches it back to the bowler. Just 2 runs from the over.
Mathews prods forward in defence. Gets a leading edge towards the cover region.
Short into the stumps, Dickwella goes for the reverse sweep. Plays it perfectly towards deep covers for a single.
Mathews drives it towards long on for a single.
Floats a leg spinner around off, Mathews kneels down and goes for a slog sweep but he fails to make contact. Gets rapped on the pads.
Tossed up outside off, Mathews lunges forward in defence.
A bit short into the pads, Mathews flicks it towards fine leg for a single.
Clipped through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Into the pads, Mathews clips it towards fine leg for a single to get off the mark.
Fuller around off, Mathews tries to clip it on the leg side. The ball doesn't spin and gets a leading edge which rolls away towards the short third man fielder.
Skipper Angelo Mathews promotes himself to number 3. A good ploy to accelerate the scoring rate.

OUT! Finally a wicket! Maybe that was the only way the Zimbabwe bowlers could manage a wicket! Short around off, zipping in. Gunathilaka is too early into his pull as he completely fails to make contact with it. Turns to find his bails rattled and Waller has successfully broken the first wicket stand. Gunathilaka has to walk back disappointed without reaching his century. A terrific knock comes to an end.
Short around middle and off, punched towards covers for a single. Again a misfield there as well.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Dickwella sweeps it towards deep backward square leg for a single.
Full toss in the line of the stumps, Dickwella paddles it through the short fine leg region for a boundary.
FOUR! Dickwella comes down the track and smashes it over the mid off region for a boundary.
Eased to long on for a single.

How do you drop those? Zimbabwe cannot surely land wickets if they are going to make a mockery of chances like these. Outside off, Gunathilaka makes some room and smashes it towards the fielder at extra cover. Solomon Mire gets behind it, the ball goes through his finger and hits him on his chin. Gunathilaka is enjoying his day out in the middle.
Dickwella gets behind the line of the ball and defends it.

Sharp turn and stumping chance missed! Tossed up outside off, spinning away with a touch of extra bounce. Dickwella comes forward and tries to clip it on the leg side. Gets beaten and the keeper fails to collect it as well. Had he kept it well, Dickwella could have been in danger.
Fuller around off, driven through wide mid off for a single. First pair ever to score back-to-back 200-plus stands for any wicket. These guys have achieved something special here.
Short and wide outside off, Dickwella throws his bat at it and drives it towards sweeper cover for a single.
Flatter delivery around middle and leg, Gunathilaka camps back and punches it towards long off for a single.
Shorter around off, the batsman cuts it towards the cover-point region for a single.
Tossed up outside off, eased down to long on for a single by Dickwella.
Fuller into the pads, Gunathilaka clips it towards fine leg for a single.
Around middle and off, Gunathilaka defends it on the leg side.
A bit short this time and Dickwella nudges it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Floats it outside off, Dickwella prods forward in defence. Ends up lobbing it towards silly mid off region.
Fuller outside off, Dickwella drives it straight back to the bowler.
Graeme Cremer is back for a bowl.

Time for Drinks! Sri Lanka are cruising with the bat and they have looked supremely comfortable in the middle. Niroshan Dickwella has marched past three figures and Danushka Gunathilaka is also getting close to it. Zimbabwe need to do something to pull things back as it is running out of their hands with every passing ball.

2ND ODI TON FOR NIROSHAN DICKWELLA! And that too back-to-back. Only the eighth Sri Lankan to achieve this feat. He couldn't have asked for an easier delivery than this. Waller bowls a half-tracker which Niroshan pulls with ease in front of square on the leg side. Completes the single and jumps in celebration of his century. What a knock it has been from him. Take a bow, young lad! He now needs to launch from hereon to take the total out of the opposition's reach.
Very full on middle and leg, dug out back to the bowler.
Another back foot punch through covers for a single.
Once again Dickwella makes room and punches it through to sweeper cover for a single. Moves to 99!
Straighter delivery on the stumps, Niroshan makes room and dabs it to short third man.
Slightly on the shorter length, sliding in. Dickwella first shuffles across, then goes back and works it through wide mid on for a couple.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Sliding away with the arm, Niroshan guides it late towards short third man for a single.
Another easy picking. Full around leg, clipped in the square leg region for a single.
Full on middle and leg, Dickwella flicks it off the front foot in the mid-wicket region for a single.
Served around leg, spinning down leg, turned with the spin on the leg side for a single.
Served full on middle and off, Gunathilaka gets across and paddle scoops it to fine leg for a couple.
Served around middle, sping away a touch. Dickwella leans forward to defend but gets it off the outer half on the off side.
Shortish delivery around off, Gunathilaka goes back and punches it through wide mid off for a single.
Waller pitches it up this time. Niroshan prods ahead and turns it on the leg side. The bowler goes after it and the batsmen complete a run.
Another back foot punch through covers for a single.
Shortish delivery, angling in, punched off the back foot to sweeper cover for a single.
Sligthly fuller around off, DG with a deft touch places towards short third man for a single.
Served around leg, flicked on the leg side for a single.
Gunathilaka stays in the crease and turns it on the leg side.
FOUR! Over the infield! Full around off, Danushka stays tall and lofts it handsomely over the bowler's head and to the long off fence. Picks up a boundary.
Around leg, sliding away, defended into the deck.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.
Full outside off, pushed to mid off.
Full and sliding in, milked down to long on for a single.
Played with soft hands in front of covers for a single.
Full toss on the pads, Gunathilaka comes down the track and has a wild swing at it. Gets it off the inner half past the square leg umpire for a brace.
Full outside off, driven through mid off for a single.
Full on middle, hurries the batsman, who does well to block it out.

Full on the stumps, slanting in. Gunathilaka is beaten again and gets rapped on the pads. The players appeal but it's turned down. The batsmen cross and the umpire signals nothing. So there might have been an inside edge.
Served around leg, Danushka stays back and works it through square leg for a single.
Full around off, driven through backward point for a single.
Gunathilaka prods forward and with soft hands nudges it in the square leg region for a single.
Slides on with the arm, punched away by making room on the off side for a single.
Shout for lbw! Landed around leg, spinning in a touch. Niroshan looks to work it across the line but misses and gets rapped on the pads. The players appeal but it's turned down. Pitched outside leg.
Served around middle and leg from around the wicket. Dickwella makes room and punches it past the diving cover fielder for a brace.
Sean Williams is back on.
Again it's on the shorter side, Dickwella goes back and punches it through covers for a single. Good over this, just a couple from it.
Slightly shorter this time, Niroshan makes room but only manages to punch it to the fielder square of the wicket on the off side.
Nice and full outside off, eased down to long off for a single.
Sliding into the pads, played with the angle to mid-wicket, where Cremer makes a good stop.
Gunathilaka goes back and defends it to covers.
Pretty close! Flatter delivery outside off, spins away ever so slightly. Beats the outside edge of Gunathilaka, who is looking to guide it late and also whizzes past the off pole.
Only the second Sri Lankan pair to share back-to-back 150-plus opening run stands in ODIs after Aravinda da Silva and Asanka Gurusinha.
On a length around off, Dickwella makes room for himself but ends up chopping it to point.
Shortish delivery, angling in, tapped in the mid-wicket region for a single.
Angling into the batsman, tucked away on the leg side for a single.
Short and wide outside off, punched to deep cover for a single.
FOUR! Pulled away! Short and angling in, Danushka gets in position early and pulls it handsomely over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Wide! Sharp bouncer from Mpofu. Gunathilaka is surprised and can't do anything about it. The umpire gives it wide for height. Mpofu is not happy with it.
Back of a length outside off, Dickwella looks to work it across but gets an inside edge behind square on the leg side for a single.
Tossed up outside off, pushed through covers for a single.
Punched to long off for a single.

Shout for lbw! Waller bowls it full around middle and off, Gunathilaka gets across and kneels down to sweep but misses. Gets rapped on the pads and the players start appealing but it's turned down. Gunathilaka wants to cross through but Dickwella sends him back. Waller has a word with his skipper for the review but doesn't take it. The Hawk Eye shows that it would have slided down the leg side.
Sliding into the batsman, Gunathilaka looks to play it across the line but misses and gets rapped on the pads.
Dickwella comes down the track. Waller sees that and drags his length back. The ball lands and spins away with extra bounce. Niroshan adjusts well and turns it on the leg side for a single.
Punched through covers for a single.
Malcolm Waller is called into the attack.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Niroshan makes room and dabs it towards point.
Shortish again, angling in this time. Pulled on the leg side for a single.

FOUR! Slashed away! The ball is on the shorter side with room on offer. Gunathilaka who has just reached his fifty won't miss out on these. He stands tall and cuts it fiercely over backward point for a boundary.
Wide! Short and down the leg side. The umpire spreads his arms to signal wide.
Banged in short, DG ducks under it.
6th ODI fifty for Danushka Gunathilaka!

Fifty for Danushka Gunathilaka! Length delivery, angling in, tucked behind square on the leg side for a couple. He hasn't batted as well as the previous game but still has gone on to register a good score, helping his side to get off to a good start.

The change works, almost! Mpofu comes from around the wicket, bowls it on a length around off. Dickwella looks to play away from his body but the angle takes the inside edge onto the pads. The ball rolls on the off side and a single is taken.
Chris Mpofu is called back for a bowl.
Niroshan dances down the track and drives it on the full to long off. He will keep the strike with this single.
Slightly shorter around off, punched off the back foot through covers for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
More work for sweeper cover! Short around off, Gunathilaka goes back and punches it solidly through covers. The fielder in the deep hares to his left and keeps them down to a brace.
Sliding into the batsman, ND makes room and punches it through the point region for a single.
Dickwella again uses his feet, drives it past the stumps at the other end. Till the time the long on fielder gets to the ball, the batsmen run two.
Served in the line of the stumps, flicked to mid-wicket.
Fuller around off, driven through covers for a single.

FOUR! Delicate! Dickwella is playing superbly. He stays in the crease, waits for the ball to come near him and then at the last moment opens the face of the bat. Gets it fine down the off side to the third man fence for another boundary.
Danushka drives this fuller delivery to long on for a single.

Dropped! My goodness! The skipper has dropped off his own bowling. Full around off, Gunathilaka bunts it straight down. Doesn't get the elevation on it and it's traveling flat back to the bowler, who gets both his hands to it but ends up dropping it. Raza runs to his skipper and tries to cheer him up. This can prove really costly for the visitors.
Full around off, tapped back to the bowler.
Shortish around off, chopped to cover-point.
Beaten again! Flatter delivery around off, spins away but not by much. Dickwella rather plays a loose shot at it and gets beaten.
Full outside off, driven to long off for a single.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Served slightly on the shorter length, Dickwella cuts it off the back foot through point for a brace.
Dickwella dances down the track and defends it down the wicket.
Dickwella stays in the crease and works it on the leg side for a single.

FOUR! Misfield! The fielders have got to back up their bowlers. Sliding away from Dickwella, he just glides it late. The short third man fielder makes a mess of an easy stop and the ball goes through to the fence behind. This is sloppy cricket!
The batsman works it down the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
In the air... but safe! Full in the line of the stumps, Dickwella goes for the paddle sweep. Gets a top edge and lobs in the short fine leg region. Moor runs after it but fails to reach there.
Driven through the mid on region. One run added to the total.
Low full toss, swept over square leg for a single.
Sean Williams is back on the field.
Danushka leans ahead and turns it on the leg side.
Beaten! Great follow-up delivery from Raza. Lands it full around off, gets it to turn away. Gunathilaka prods forward in defence but gets beaten.
Sharp turn! Served outside off, turns away a long way. Gunathilaka is surprised by it and can only stand and admire.
Poor delivery. Short outside off, Danushka goes back and punches it hard through covers. The sweeper cover covers good ground to his left and saves a couple of runs for his side.
Gunathilaka dances down and pushes it back to the bowler.
Sliding into the batsman, Niroshan goes back and punches it in the wide mid on region for a single.
Change of ends for Sikandar Raza.
Dickwella eases it down past the bowler, to long on for a single.
Played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Full on middle, swept through backward square leg for a single.
Served outside off, sliding away, punched off the back foot through covers for a single.
Full outside off, driven to long on for a single.
Tossed up around off, Dickwella kneels down and paddle sweeps it fine down the leg side. Takes a brace. Only the fourth Lankan pair to get back-to-back century stands.

Time for Drinks! The Sri Lankan openers have continued from where they left off in the previous game. They are just one short of another century stand. Zimbabwe need to get their act together quickly.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Good length delivery outside off, Dickwella drives it towards point for a single.
Short around off, Dickwella pulls it through the backward square leg region. The fielder from fine leg rushes to his right and makes a good stop.
Length around off, driven towards mid off. The fielder there makes a good stop. Only a single is taken.
Wide! Fuller and sprayed down the leg side, Gunathilaka tries to flick it through but makes no contact. The umpire signals it as a wide.
Fuller around off, clipped through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Fuller into the pads, worked towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
5th ODI fifty for Niroshan Dickwella! It also has gone dark out there now.
Fifty! Fuller around middle and off, worked towards mid-wicket for a single. Dickwella has started off really well again and he would look to score another century today.
Gunathilaka camps back and pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
A bit shorter around off, Gunathilaka camps back and defends it.
Fuller around off, Gunathilaka makes room and drills it towards the fielder at mid off.
Floats it around off, Dickwella drives it towards long on for a single.
Graeme Cremer brings himself into the attack now.
Good length delivery outside off, Gunathilaka tries to run it down towards third man but he fails to make contact there.
Dickwella shuffles across and pulls it towards long leg for a single.
Gunathilaka clips it on the leg side for a single.
FOUR! Good shot! Short and wide outside off, Gunathilaka steps out of his crease and throws his bat at it. Goes over the mid off region for a boundary.
Length delivery outside off, Dickwella goes for the drive. Gets it towards mid-wicket off the inner half.

Williams has done his hamstring after a superb piece of fielding. The team physio is out there to treat him. He is now going off the field. Not good sign for the visitors. He is such an important player for the them.

Danushka is lucky there! Short delivery outside off, Dickwella cuts it towards the fielder at point. Williams dives to his right and makes a fine stop. There was a bit of hesitation in the middle but Sean throws it at the striker's end, which proves to be the wrong end. Gunathilaka was the one who was way out of his crease and had almost reached the striker's end. The back up fielders are also far and this makes Danushka to come back with ease.
FOUR! Width and punished! Short and wide outside off, Gunathilaka camps back and punches it powerfully through the cover region for a boundary.
Fuller into the pads, Gunathilaka clips it towards the fielder at short fine leg.
A bit shorter outside off, Dickwella punches it through the point for a single.
Outside off, driven through mid off for a single.
Shorter around leg, Gunathilaka makes room and punches it towards covers off the back foot.
Dickwella comes down the track and defends on the leg side. Raza himself goes after the ball and as a result an easy single is completed.

Good length delivery outside off, Gunathilaka tries to chop it on the off side. Gets an inside edge and the ball sticks into the pads. The keeper comes running towards it but Danushka takes it out with his hands and throws it back to the keeper.
Length delivery around off, punched through the cover region for a couple.
A cover-point comes in place.
Wide! A bit short down the leg side, Gunathilaka tries to pull it but fails to make contact. The umpire signals a wide.
Length delivery outside off, Dickwella slashes hard at it. Gets it past the point fielder for a couple.
Shortish delivery outside off, Gunathilaka cuts it towards the point region. The fielder there misfields and allows the batsmen to take a single.
Fuller around off, Gunathilaka lunges forward in defence.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Dickwella runs it down towards third man for a single.
Solomon Mire is brought in for a bowl.
Niroshan Dickwella seems to be suffering from some groin cramps. The team physio is out there to help him with some stretching exercise.
Fuller around middle and leg, clipped towards mid-wicket. The fielder dives to his left to stop it. Only a single taken.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Floated around middle, Gunathilaka comes down the track and blocks it. Gets hit on the body on the bounce.
Clipped towards mid-wicket for a single.
Two Wides! Floated down the leg side, beats the batsman but also the keeper who lets it through his legs. The batsmen run a bye and the umpire signals it as a wide as well.
A bit short around middle and off, Dickwella punches it towards the fielder at covers off the back foot.
Angling into the pads, clipped towards mid-wicket for a single.
Powerplay 2 is signalled! Now, a maximum of 4 fielders are allowed outside the circle till the 40th over.
FOUR! Luck favours the brave! Fuller into the pads, Gunathilaka shuffles across and goes for the sweep. Gets a bottom edge to it and the ball races away through the fine leg region for a boundary.
A bit short around off, Gunathilaka camps back and punches it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Flicked straight towards the fielder at Gunathilaka.
Fuller around leg, Gunathilaka tries to clip it on the leg side. Gets it towards the cover region off the leading edge.
Eased towards long on for a single.
Flatter around the pads, Dickwella pushes it back to the bowler.
Spin from both ends as Sean Williams is brought into the attack from the other end.

A run out chance missed! Flighted delivery, Dickwella comes down the track and clips it towards the fielder at mid on for a quick single. The fielder has a shy at the non-striker's end but he misses. Had he hit, Dickwella was a goner as he was running across.
Tossed up around leg, Dickwella gets to the pitch of the ball and blocks it away.
Fuller around leg, Dickwella clips it through the mid-wicket region for a couple.
Fuller around off, Dickwella drives it straight back to the bowler. Raza fields that well.

Around middle and leg, Dickwella clips it towards mid-wicket and calls for a single but Gunathilaka sends him back. The fielder has a wild throw at the striker's end and luckily for him there was good covering.
Floated around middle and leg, Dickwella gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it.
Sikandar Raza is introduced into the attack.
Good length delivery outside off, Gunathilaka gets behind the ball to defend it. The ball rolls away towards the keeper.
Again short into the body, Gunathilaka flicks it through the backward square leg region for a couple.
Again a bit short into the body, Dickwella just flicks it towards fine leg for a single.
FOUR! Good shot! Width on offer and Dickwella pounces on it as he drives it beautifully past the point fielder for a boundary.
Fuller delivery around off, Dickwella drives it on the off side.
Back of a length delivery into the batsman, Dickwella works it through the square leg region for a couple.
FOUR! Into the action, Gunathilaka! Good length delivery in the line of the stumps, Danushka comes down the track and smacks that straight over the bowler, through the mid on region for a boundary.
Length delivery around off, Gunathilaka defends it on the leg side and calls for a quick single but Dickwella sends him back.
Wide! Bangs this short but just sliding down the leg side, Gunathilaka lets it sail over him and the umpire signals it as a wide.
Short delivery into the batsman, pulled towards fine leg for a single.
Fuller and angling into the stumps, Dickwella defends it well from his crease.
Slower delivery around off, Dickwella defends it with soft hands towards the cover region for a quick single.
Back of a length delivery outside off, dabbed towards the fielder at short third man.
FOUR! Makes room and hammers it! Good length delivery outside off, Dickwella goes leg side to make room. Enjoys some width on it and smashes it over the cover region for a boundary.
Angling into the hips, worked on the leg side for a single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Good length delivery outside off, the ball holds its line. Gunathilaka feels for it and gets beaten.
Fuller outside off, Dickwella reaches out to it and drives it through the cover-point region. The ball does not reach the fence as the fielder cuts it off. Three runs taken.
Wide! Chatara misses his line again as he sprays it down the leg side.
Good length delivery outside off, Dickwella gets behind the line of the ball to defend it.
Good length delivery outside off, punched through the extra cover region. The batsmen run three and that ends a successful over for Sri Lanka. 12 runs off it.

FOUR! Succeeds in making room this time! Dickwella goes leg side again, Mpofu bangs this short and follows the batsman. Niroshan cuts that really late past the gully fielder for a boundary. Nice shot.
FOUR! Finally a boundary! Fuller delivery outside off, Dickwella drives it through the wide mid off region for a boundary.
Dickwella tries to make some room again but Mpofu also follows him with a fuller length delivery. Drives this one towards the fielder at mid off.
Angling into the pads, clipped through the square leg region for a single.
Good length delivery outside off, Dickwella shoulders his arms to it.
Length delivery, tucked away through the square leg region for a single.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Dickwella goes leg side to make some room but Chatara is smart enough to follow him. Bowls it to on a length, Dickwella can only defend it.
Wide! Sprayed down the leg side, Dickwella fails to clip it through. The umpire is quick to signal it as a wide.
Good length delivery, angling into the hips. Gunathilaka shuffles a bit and nurdles it behind square leg for a single.
Fuller around middle, clipped through mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller delivery around middle and off, Dickwella defends it neatly.
Fuller into the pads, Dickwella clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Length delivery outside off, Dickwella pushes it straight to the fielder at point.
Slower on a length around off, worked towards mid-wicket by Gunathilaka for a single.
Fuller around off, driven back to the bowler. Mpofu goes to his left to make a good stop.
Angling into the stumps from a length, Gunathilaka defends it back to the bowler. No runs taken.
Fuller outside off, driven towards wide mid off for a single.
Again sprayed into the pads, Dickwella clips it towards fine leg for an easy single.
Angling into the pads, clipped through mid-wicket for a single.
Length delivery outside off, Gunathilaka tries to poke at it but gets beaten by the ball straightening after pitching. He is lucky not to edge it.
Fuller around off, Dickwella goes for the drive. Gets it off the inner half through the mid-wicket region for a single.
Fuller around off, Dickwella gets his bat down on time but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Comes around the wicket, angles it into the pads. Gunathilaka clips it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Tendai Chatara will bowl with the second new ball from the other end.
Back of a length delivery into the batsman, Dickwella is surprised by the extra bounce as he defends it off the back foot.
Full and wide outside off, Dickwella jams it towards the fielder at covers.
Fuller outside off, Dickwella shuffles across and tries to drive it on the off side. But only manages to get an inside edge onto his pads.
Length around off, pushed towards mid on off the back foot.
Good length delivery outside off, Dickwella gets behind the line of the ball and defends it.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Angling into the pads, Dickwella does not miss out this time. Gets a bit of bat on it and the ball races away to the fine leg fence.
Wide! Starts of with a wide, sprays it way down the leg side. Dickwella still goes behind it but it was too wide for him.

The players are out in the middle. Danushka Gunathilaka and Niroshan Dickwella will open the batting for Sri Lanka. Chris Mpofu to start the proceedings for Zimbabwe with the first new ball. Here we go...

Graeme Cremer says that he would have bowled first had he won the toss and so he is not much disappointed. Reckons that they will be backing themselves to chase the total down as they are batting heavy. Mentions Chris Mpofu comes in place of Carl Mumba. Informs that they thought of adding an extra bowler but they trust their batsmen to chase any total down.

Angelo Mathews says that they will have a bat first. Adds that the pitch looks dry and so this choice. Informs that Nuwan Pradeep is injured and ASITHA FERNANDO WILL MAKE HIS DEBUT. Says that he bowls fast. Ends by saying that they are trying to improve in each of the three departments.
TOSS - Sri Lanka win the toss and opt to bat.

PITCH REPORT - Rusell Arnold says that the wind is blowing slightly less than the previous game and the boundaries have been pushed back. On the pitch, he says it's a good, hard pitch. If the ball lands in the patches, it will do something. The ball will hold up from the good length area. Reckons that the bowlers should get it fuller and take the cross-batted shots out of the equation. Also mentions that there will be some turn for the spinners.

The visitors after losing the last match, find themselves in a must-win situation. They will have to win today to take this ODI series down to wire. Zimbabwe scored above 300 for the second time in the series but still ended up losing courtesy of a mammoth opening stand from the opposition. They will hope for a similar outing with the bat and to step up in the bowling and fielding department. With weather staying the same as the last game, expect a cracker.

Hello and a warm welcome to the 4th ODI between Sri Lanka and Zimbabwe at Hambantota. After getting a wake-up call in the first match, Sri Lanka won the next two handsomely and have taken a crucial lead in the series. A win today will seal the deal for them and Mathews would expect a clinical performance from his boys.
